visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long straight brown hair and bangs, wearing a grey off-shoulder knit dress with a black belt and black boots, stands outside a 3C store called WANTBUY. She points towards the glass doors and smiles at the camera against an urban sidewalk backdrop. (2) The woman enters the store and sits at a clean, white counter that resembles a cafe setting. She holds an iPhone 16 Pro Max box and gestures towards prices displayed on a screen, maintaining a high-energy facial expression and bright smile. (3) The scene shifts to product showcases. The woman takes phone cases from a wall display, handles a silver B&O speaker, and demonstrates a portable grey projector. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the electronics and the glossy packaging. (4) The woman is seen interacting with a male clerk behind a desk. They both look at a smartphone screen and a large calculator. She holds up the calculator displaying '10000' and '13000' to the camera, gesturing excitedly. (5) The woman stands next to a large gashapon machine with white and gold balls, giving a thumbs up. The final shot shows her back outside in a parking area in front of the store's large yellow and black signage, waving goodbye.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main character/host; 1 male store employee appearing in transaction segments.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Young woman with long brown hair, bangs, wearing a grey off-shoulder knit dress, black belt, and black knee-high boots.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Modern 3C retail interior with white shelving, minimalist wooden counters, and a marble reception wall. The exterior is a storefront on an urban street with parking spaces.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music begins with a steady kick drum and bright synth lead. A female narrator speaks with high energy and a fast speech rate. (2) A sharp, high-pitched 'ding' SFX marks the introduction of the store's name, followed by a digital 'whoosh' as the acoustic space transitions. (3) The BGM maintains a 120 BPM tempo. Subtle rustling sounds and soft percussive thuds occur as objects are handled, but they are mixed well below the clear, professional narration. (4) Another melodic 'stinger' SFX plays during the price comparison phase. The narrator’s pitch rises slightly to emphasize value, while the BGM provides a consistent rhythmic bed. (5) A bubbly 'pop' SFX accompanies the final visual transitions. The track concludes with the narrator's voice and music fading simultaneously on a positive, rising cadence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interior Tour -> Price Value Proposition -> Inventory Variety -> Service Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the comprehensive retail services of the WANTBUY 3C store, highlighting competitive pricing, product diversity (smartphones, speakers, projectors), and specialized financial/trade-in services.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is dedicated to showcasing a specific store's location, products, and services with clear branding.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished, social-media native promotional video that leverages influencer marketing to drive foot traffic to a local electronics retail chain.
